title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Denishua WPJAM…
description: A reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Denishua WPJAM Basic plugin versions up to 7.1.2. This flaw allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute arbitrary scripts in users' browsers. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.1.
